description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Ornithopter.
Rograkh dies, triggering Koll, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, targeting Rograkh.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Koll, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.
